id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

uiTimezone.description: Field used to represent the user's selected timezone which will be used to convert timestamps in the UI.

uiTimezoneLabel.description: Field used to represent the display label for the user's selected timezone.

uiTimezoneOffset.description: Field used to represent the offset information for the user's selected timezone.

selectedEntityId.description:
The id of the currently selected entity.
Used in various grids to store the id of the most recently selected row.

selectedEntityIds.description:
The ids of the currently selected entity.
Used in grids to store the id of the grid where the action was triggered

selectedAssetId.description: The id of the currently selected asset {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

selectedSidePanelEntityId.description:
The id of the currently selected side panel entity.
Used in various side panel components to store the id of the selected alert.

selectedTopFailureModeCardListItemId.description: The id of the selected item on CaseDetail and AlertDetail Page.

selectedRowData.description:
The row data for the selected editable row in the grid.
Used in various grids to store the entire contents of the most recently selected row.

selectedCardData.description: The card data for the card being viewed in a card list.

inlineNotificationConfig.description: Used to set title, subtitle and visibility of an inline notification.

filterPanelValue.description:
The value of the filter panel, when the submit button is clicked.
Used to store the filter panel values in the application state and retrieve them later.

configIds.description:
The Prediction Configuration ids for the selected editable row in the grid
Used for bulk retraining models

selectedTopFailureModeCardListItemFMLIId.description: The id of the FMLI of the selected item on TopFailureModeCardList on CaseDetail and AlertDetail Page.

selectedFMRecommendationsGridItemId.description: The id of the item selected in Recommendations Grid on CaseDetail and AlertDetail Page.

selectedName.description: The name of the currently selected entity.

selectedNameSidePanel.description: The name of the currently selected entity for the side panel.

addToCaseFromSidePanel.description: A boolean flag to indicate whether the user is adding to a case from the alert detail side panel.

allFacilities.description:
The list of all the {@link Facility#id}s that currently logged in user has been assigned to.
This list of IDs serves as the source of truth to perform facility-based filtering on any relevant UI components.

isUserUnauthorized.description:
This field determines if the current {@link User} has access to the entity, to whose detail page they are navigating to.
On page load, this field is populated in `checkUserAuthorizationEpic`.

selectedFacilities.description:
The list of {@link Facility#id}s obtained from the selected facilities in the global dropdown filter.
This list of IDs serves as the source of truth to perform facility-based filtering on any relevant UI components.

contentFrameSubtitle.description: The string contents for names of {@link ReliabilityApplicationState#selectedFacilities} names separated by commas.

fmliToBeDeleted.description: The id of the FailureModeLineItem to be deleted.

comparisonModel.description: The MLPredictonConfiguration to compare on the Model Detail Page.

presetFilterPanelStatus.description: When set to true, allows the user to preset filter panel values with Chart configuration data.

latestCorrelationConfig.description:
Settings set by users from the Bulk Sensor Association UI.

**Note**: This field is used for Latest Correlation Configuration Page, and is populated using
{LatestCorrelationFetchDataEpic}.

selectedAlertParentIds.description: The list of ids of the parents to be fetch for an alert. This is used for showing the comments and files on the Case Detail Page.

selectedComment.description: The id of the selected comment for which the files need to fetched in the Alert Detail Page.

showSwapAssetAffectedSensorGrid.description: Determines whether to render the Swap Asset Sensor Affected Sensor Grid in Swap Asset Class UI Workflow.

selectedAssetModelRelation.description: Selected {@link ReliabilityAssetToModelRelation} used to plot the features in Asset Details - Asset Models.

selectedChartDate.description:
AssetDetailModelsModelOutputChart
 Selected necessary date data used to plot the {AssetDetailModelsModelOutputChartHelper} in
 Asset Details - Asset Models.

alertFilteringStartDate.description:
Filter used on "To Do Alerts" page for filtering alerts by date.
Updated by {ToDoAlertsDateRangeSelectorEpic} when the date range is changed, or the page is loaded using
{ToDoAlertsDateRangeSelectorPrepopulationEpic}.

**NOTE**: Is expected that this field contains a date in ISO format. (ex: `2024-04-11T06:00:00.000Z`)

workOrdersGridId.description: Stores the id of the grid component to refresh after creating a new {@link WorkOrder}.

retrainModelDataSourceId.description: Field used to retrieve the base model information, this should be a component ID.

sensorSettingsModalConfigData.description:
Modal data used when opening a Sensor Settings Modal
See {@link Sensor#updateMonitorSettings} and {@link Sensor#updateOperatingStatusSettings}.

dataSourceIdToRefreshOnComplete - the source component dataSpec_ds where the SensorSettingsModal was opened from. Used to refresh grids after update
monitorSettingsEnabled - used in the cases where the call to operatingStatusUpdateRequest is needed only and the monitorSettingsUpdateRequest can be skipped

mlProjectId.description:
Represent the current ML project ID to be considered in current context.

Currently being used by the update model modal to determine the type of ml model being cloned.
